stories.subject: Don Toliver / Manchester Co-op Live evacuation
stories.summary: More than 12,000 people were evacuated from Don Toliver’s Manchester concert after an unknown substance sickened people in the crowd; authorities reported more than 80 medical treatments and an ongoing investigation.

stories.subject: Kyivstoner / alleged plots in Denmark and Poland
stories.summary: Polish authorities said Albert Vasiliev, who performs as Kyivstoner, was allegedly targeted in a Warsaw plot in August after Denmark disclosed a separate suspected Russian-backed plan before a September concert near Copenhagen.

stories.subject: Havoc / Prodigy estate lawsuit
stories.summary: Prodigy’s estate sued Havoc and related companies, alleging it was denied a share of Mobb Deep show and merchandise proceeds; Havoc publicly said he hoped to resolve the dispute amicably. The allegations have not been proven in court.

stories.subject: Travis Scott / Cactus Jack x Rockstar x Nike GTA VI collection
stories.summary: The GTA VI-inspired Cactus Jack x Rockstar Games x Nike Air Force 1 collection was scheduled for a Nov. 23 Cactus Jack release after SNKRS and select-retailer launches.

stories.subject: GTA VI / cut minigames and closed casinos
stories.summary: Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson told VGC that darts and bowling were not included because the team could not bring them to its quality bar; PC Gamer reported that Leonida’s casinos and go-kart track remained closed after the main story.
